title: Euclidean description and Möbius invariance of the cut disks
statement: For v∈ℂ and real ε define D(v,ε)={z∈ℂ:Im z>0 and |(z−v)/(z−conj(v))|≤ε}. If Im v>0 and 0<ε<1, then D(v,ε) is the Euclidean closed disk with center Re v+i Im v(1+ε²)/(1−ε²) and radius 2 Im v ε/(1−ε²). Furthermore, for any real a,b,c,d satisfying ad−bc=1, the map M(z)=(az+b)/(cz+d) satisfies M(D(v,ε))=D(M(v),ε).
lean_statement: let D : ℂ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun v ε => {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im ∧ ‖(z - v) / (z - star v)‖ ≤ ε}; ∀ (v : ℂ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < v.im → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → D v ε = Metric.closedBall ((v.re : ℂ) + ((v.im * (1 + ε ^ 2) / (1 - ε ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * v.im * ε / (1 - ε ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ a b c d : ℝ, a * d - b * c = 1 → let M : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((a : ℂ) * z + (b : ℂ)) / ((c : ℂ) * z + (d : ℂ)); M '' (D v ε) = D (M v) ε
